# int

Integer values

## Index

| Operation               | Description                         
|-------------------------|-------------------------------------
| [`int-data`](#int-data) | Converts integer to big-endian bytes


## Operations

### int-data

Converts the integer *x* to its binary representation in big-endian
order.

Stack effects:
```
( x:Int -- Data )
```

Example:

| Input             | Stack       
|-------------------|-------------
| `0x1234 int-data` | `data: 1234`
